name: aem-layout-view trigger queries
description: Should trigger when EDS block or site code must stay editable in Experience Workspace layout view (WYSIWYG): uneditable text or images, duplicates after edits, CORS failures only in layout view, branch testing there, requirements. Near misses are Universal Editor models (ue-component-model), generic block building, library entries (aem-block-library), content models, tests, performance, DA page HTML and code review.

queries.query: Authors say they can't edit the card titles of our `cards` block in Experience Workspace layout view, although the page looks right. Fix the block.
In layout view of Experience Workspace, authors can't click or drag-replace the images in our `hero` block. What's wrong?
After an author adds a block in the Experience Workspace page editor, our page shows two lifecycle badges and the carousel autoplay runs twice.
Our block's API call works on .aem.page but fails inside the Experience Workspace WYSIWYG editor with a CORS error. What do we change?
I changed the `tabs` block on a branch. How do I check it in Experience Workspace layout view before merging?
Make the `testimonial` block work in layout view so authors can edit it in place.
Spacing jumps while authors type in the paragraphs of our `hero` block in the Experience Workspace editor. Our CSS uses `.hero > div > p`.
What does our site's head.html and scripts.js need so layout view works in Experience Workspace?
The icons our block adds into the headings disappear when authors click into the text in the EW layout editor.
Review our `feature-list` block for anything that would break layout view editing in Experience Workspace.
Our xwalk project's `hero` block isn't editable in the Universal Editor. Fix the component model.
Build a new `timeline` block with a compact variant. Follow our normal workflow.
Add the finished `testimonial` block to the block library so authors can insert it.
Design the content model for a pricing table block that authors edit in Experience Workspace.
Write Playwright E2E tests for the `tabs` block against its library page.
The hero block's LCP is slow in PageSpeed Insights. Improve it.
Write the HTML for a DA page with a hero and three cards and push it with the CLI.
Review this pull request that changes the `accordion` block's CSS and JS.
